article.content: Roaring exports lift China’s economic growth Chris Beauchamp , chief market analyst at investing and trading platform IG , said: Investors worried about political flashpoints will be watching France nervously. Given the country’s precarious financial situation, the riots of recent weeks may only be a foretaste of what is to come should any government attempt to reform public spending. While other European markets enjoyed a stronger period last week, the CAC continued its miserable performance. But betting on France’s recuperative powers has been the way to go in previous crises - can the Fifth Republic pull off a similar trick again? Continue reading...
